tagline: Short handmade-world ads for brands that already have stop-motion or animated shots: the characters act first with no text, small pale-yellow captions only when they talk, the product shows up inside the world, and the wordmark closes on black.
needs: your brand's own stop-motion or animated shots (9:16), your wordmark file, and pack shots for the on-screen product spot
readiness_note: For brands and agencies only: the engine edits, captions and closes your animation, it cannot make the stop-motion itself.

captions: Frame 0: a felt character already mid-action in a miniature forest, no text; a white two-line caption fades in on the first word
Product broadcast: label words and a pack shot take turns on an in-world TV screen, with static between channels
The close: a soft iris shrinks on the characters, then the wordmark sits alone on black
